ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHAPED_GLASS.descriptio: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] all Attacks in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Design[/purple] and lose half your Max HP.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHAPED_GLASS.eventDescr: [gold]Enchant[/gold] all Attacks in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Design[/purple] and lose half your Max HP.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHAPED_GLASS.flavor: As the sharpness of the edge drives you, it also makes you brittle.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHAPED_GLASS.title: Shaped Glass
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARSEED.description: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] card rewards. Add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Egocentrism[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARSEED.eventDescripti: Obtain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] card rewards. Add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Egocentrism[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARSEED.flavor: It sounds like two brothers, chasing glass frogs in the sun.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARSEED.title: Starseed
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHARED_DESIGN.descripti: At the end of combat, you may remove [blue]2[/blue] cards from your deck if you took no unblocked attack damage.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHARED_DESIGN.flavor: Through flawless design, you may seek perfection.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHARED_DESIGN.title: Shared Design
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FLAWLESS_HAMMER.descrip: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [color=#2596be]Break Beneath Me[/color] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FLAWLESS_HAMMER.flavor: Elegant design. Heavy mass. A drop of blood. Yes, this will do perfectly.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FLAWLESS_HAMMER.title: Flawless Hammer
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-ANCIENT_SCEPTER.flavor: The crystal pulsates with powerful energy as you pick it up.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-ANCIENT_SCEPTER.title: Ancient Scepter
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FRACTURED_BLADE.descrip: After your first turn, take an extra turn. Whenever you play a card on your first turn, lose [blue]1[/blue] Max HP.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FRACTURED_BLADE.flavor: A massive crack runs down the length of the blade.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FRACTURED_BLADE.title: Fractured Blade
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PILLAR_OF_MASS.flavor: Mass is simple. The base of all forms, shaped and molded. Take this, and create your own vision.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PILLAR_OF_MASS.title: Pillar Of Mass
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-ARTIFACT_OF_COMMAND.des: Upon pickup, choose any [blue]1[/blue] non-special card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-ARTIFACT_OF_COMMAND.eve: Choose any [blue]1[/blue] non-special card to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-ARTIFACT_OF_COMMAND.fla: "Take a sip of the drink, and the mind becomes malleable....and the world around you follows your example." - Sigibold the Drunken
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MONSOON_CHARM.descripti: All combats drop an additional relic. [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] are replaced with [gold]Elites[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MONSOON_CHARM.flavor: Rain pours down on your head. You feel a sense of dread as you hold it.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MONSOON_CHARM.title: Monsoon Charm
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-EULOGY_ZERO.description: Combat relic rewards are replaced with random non-Neow [gold]Ancient[/gold] relics.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-EULOGY_ZERO.flavor: "Architect...your death is fated. When you die - and you WILL die - I will be ready. I have been patient for millennia. This Spire...is mine."
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-EULOGY_ZERO.title: Eulogy Zero
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FLASH_BEACON.descriptio: Every [blue]{Turns}[/blue] turns, ALL enemies lose [blue]{FlashBeaconPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] for [blue]1[/blue] turn.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FLASH_BEACON.flavor: "Truth be told, I hate this one. Damn thing hurts my eyes. Just..keep it pointed away, would ya?"
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FLASH_BEACON.title: Flash Beacon
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SEBASTIANS_SCANNER.desc: Upon pickup, mark [blue]{Combats}[/blue] random combats. Rewards in those rooms include an additional relic reward.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SEBASTIANS_SCANNER.even: Mark [blue]{Combats}[/blue] random combats. Rewards in those rooms include an additional relic reward.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SEBASTIANS_SCANNER.flav: "You want the scanner? What, am I not good enough at finding things for you?~ Fine, fine, but if you break it, I'll rip off your head, got it?"
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MEDICAL_KIT.description: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion slot with a [gold]Neloprephine Shot[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MEDICAL_KIT.flavor: "This one's not anything special. Just contains a collection of bandages, gauze, some tools and implements, and a good amount of this miracle serum I found."
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MEDICAL_KIT.title: Medical Kit
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-WILDLIFE_DOCUMENTS.desc: At the start of combat, apply [blue]{DisadvantagedPower}[/blue] [gold]Disadvantaged[/gold] to ALL enemies.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-WILDLIFE_DOCUMENTS.flav: "This should contain everything you need to know about all the monsters and freaks you may encounter in the Spire. Written by yours truly, of course~"
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SEBBY_CHARM.flavor: "Fine, fine. Since you're just so fond of me for some reason, how about a little charm? Best I can do, terribly sorry~"
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SEBBY_CHARM.title: Sebby Charm
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHOTGUN_SHELLS.descript: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Triple Barrel Shotgun[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHOTGUN_SHELLS.flavor: "Ahh, definitely one of my favorite inventions from the gizmo makers back in R&D. Just be sure to bring it back in one piece, yeah?"
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHOTGUN_SHELLS.title: Shotgun Shells
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIPPING_REQUEST.descri: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Heavy Crate[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [red]Weighed Down[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The crate will be opened after defeating the boss.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIPPING_REQUEST.eventD: Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Heavy Crate[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [red]Weighed Down[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. The crate will be opened after defeating the boss.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIPPING_REQUEST.flavor: "The big crate? Yeah, you can have it, and whatever's inside. You'll have to head on up to get the key, though, I dropped the damn thing and I'm pretty sure the big guy at the top of this layer has it."
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIPPING_REQUEST.title: Shipping Request
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GLOWING_VIAL.descriptio: You may [gold]Mutate[/gold] any number of times at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] as a free action.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GLOWING_VIAL.flavor: "Hey, be careful with this one now, it's pretty potent. You might feel one or two of your bones breaking. That means it's working!"
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GLOWING_VIAL.title: Glowing Vial
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SALINE_INFUSER.flavor: "Ooh, I love this thing! Adds a nice salty taste to anything you drink. Might even be able to bring out a little extra life in those potions you're fond of..."
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SALINE_INFUSER.title: Saline Infuser
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-EXPERIMENTAL_SERUM.flav: "Can't say I recommend the serum. It's horribly painful, no matter how rewarding the results may be."
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FILM_ROLL.flavor: A dusty roll of camera film. Strange symbols are inscribed upon it.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FILM_ROLL.title: Film Roll
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PROSPECTING_PICK.flavor: A heavy pickaxe, rusted with time. Any rocks struck with it seem to mysteriously be filled with gold.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PROSPECTING_PICK.title: Prospecting Pick
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PACK_RAT.description: Enemies drop an additional random reward.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PACK_RAT.flavor: A small rat with a pack far too large for it. It occasionally offers you various items, though you do not know where it procures them.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-PACK_RAT.title: Pack Rat
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GOOBERT.description: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GOOBERT.eventDescriptio: Obtain an additional copy of up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GOOBERT.flavor: You have no idea what this is.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-GOOBERT.title: Goobert
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-BONE_LORD_BOON.descript: Enemies in non-Boss combats have [blue]{HpPercentage}%[/blue] less HP.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-BONE_LORD_BOON.flavor: A token of ivory with a bone marked into it. You feel blessed while carrying it.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-BONE_LORD_BOON.title: Bone Lord's Boon
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-CARVING_KNIFE.descripti: The first [gold]Hand[/gold] you draw each combat costs [blue]1[/blue] less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} that turn.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-CARVING_KNIFE.flavor: A pristine knife, shaped for carving wood. You can hear whispers from the totems you carve with it.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-CARVING_KNIFE.title: Carving Knife
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FISH_HOOK.description: At the start of each [gold]Elite[/gold] combat, [gold]Stun[/gold] ALL enemies.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FISH_HOOK.flavor: A steel fishing hook. Nothing remarkable about it presents itself.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FISH_HOOK.title: Fish Hook
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-THE_MOON.description: Whenever you would receive [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, reduce it to [blue]{DamageMaximum}[/blue].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-THE_MOON.flavor: A miniature replica of a celestial body. It seems to be made of real moon rocks.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-THE_MOON.title: Miniature Moon
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SQUIRREL_IN_A_BOTTLE.de: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Squirrel|Squirrels}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SQUIRREL_IN_A_BOTTLE.fl: A playing card, drawn to appear as if it were a squirrel. You feel uneasy as you stare at it.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-THE_SMOKE.description: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} and gain {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-THE_SMOKE.flavor: Smoke from an expired candle, preserved in glass. Some of it leaks out, tainting your breath.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-THE_SMOKE.title: The Smoke
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MYSTERIOUS_TABLET.flavo: The hooded figure told you to be careful with these spells. It would be wise to listen.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MYSTERIOUS_TABLET.title: Mysterious Tablet
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MANA_FLOWER.description: At the start of your turn, procure and use a random potion. Attacks deal [blue]{DamageDecrease}%[/blue] less damage.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MANA_FLOWER.flavor: A lush, blue flower grows from the bottle. It's presence invigorates you.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-MANA_FLOWER.title: Mana Flower
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FALLEN_STAR.flavor: A shard of the heavens that crash landed, now yours to wield.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-FALLEN_STAR.title: Fallen Star
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-REFINED_CHLOROPHYTE.des: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold] and permanently increase it by [blue]{Scaling}[/blue].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-REFINED_CHLOROPHYTE.fla: The strange metal in your hands seems to pulse and glow, as if growing even as you watch it.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIMMERING_BOTTLE.descr: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the end of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIMMERING_BOTTLE.flavo: The liquid inside holds prismatic hues. Anything brought too close begins to warp and shift, as if viewed through a kaleidoscope.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SHIMMERING_BOTTLE.title: Shimmering Bottle
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SOLAR_BRAZIER.descripti: Upon pickup, remove up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the start of your turn, take [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SOLAR_BRAZIER.eventDesc: Remove up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the start of your turn, take [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SOLAR_BRAZIER.flavor: The flame roars endlessly, devouring everything you feed into it. The heat is unbearable.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-SOLAR_BRAZIER.title: Solar Brazier
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-VORTEX_EYE.description: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]{DamagePercentage}%[/blue] more damage for the rest of combat.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-VORTEX_EYE.flavor: As you touch the fragment, you feel your eye transform, and your focus is sharpened beyond reality.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-VORTEX_EYE.title: Vortex Eye
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-NEBULA_TOME.description: At the start of your turn, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Powers to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold] that's free to play this turn, and shuffle [blue]{Status}[/blue] [gold]Cosmic Dusts[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-NEBULA_TOME.flavor: The tome beckons you, promising power beyond your wildest dreams. Glowing dust coats your hands as you turn the pages.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-NEBULA_TOME.title: Nebula Tome
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARDUST_SHACKLES.descr: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} with [purple]Celestial[/purple]. The first card drawn each turn is Afflicted with [gold]Shackled[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARDUST_SHACKLES.event: [gold]Enchant[/gold] up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} with [purple]Celestial[/purple]. The first card drawn each turn is Afflicted with [gold]Shackled[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARDUST_SHACKLES.flavo: The shackles are heavy, gilded with starlight. One can only wonder what they were made to restrain.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-STARDUST_SHACKLES.title: Stardust Shackles
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-WHISPERING_TENDRILS.sel: Select any number of cards to add to your Deck.
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-WHISPERING_TENDRILS.des: Upon pickup, add up to [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Lunacy|Lunacies}+[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
ANCIENTSAWAKENED-WHISPERING_TENDRILS.fla: Tendrils perforate your sight, beckoning you with visions of greatness. You can feel your mind growing numb.
